{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1782742210852,"sessionID":"ses_0ec4bf7a7fferOdI4AXsIMyN02","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"call_019f13b7589873c282b4d84d","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import argparse\nimport os\nimport warnings\n\nwarnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\")\n\nimport cv2\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nimport torch\nfrom PIL import Image\nfrom tqdm import tqdm\n\nfrom mobile_sam import SamPredictor, sam_model_registry\n\n\ndef parse_args():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"Refine cell masks using MobileSAM.\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--weights_path\", type=str, required=True,\n                        help=\"Path to the MobileSAM weights file.\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--output_path\", type=str, required=True,\n                        help=\"Path to the output folder where the new masks will be saved.\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--rgb_path\", type=str, required=True,\n                        help=\"Path to the RGB image.\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--csv_path\", type=str, required=True,\n                        help=\"Path to the metadata CSV.\")\n    return parser.parse_args()\n\n\ndef load_image(path):\n    img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)\n    if img is None:\n        img = np.array(Image.open(path).convert(\"RGB\"))\n        img = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)\n    img = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)\n    return img\n\n\ndef coords_to_int_list(value):\n    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):\n        return [int(round(float(v))) for v in value]\n    if pd.isna(value):\n        return []\n    s = str(value).strip()\n    if s.startswith(\"[\") and s.endswith(\"]\"):\n        s = s[1:-1]\n    if s == \"\":\n        return []\n    parts = [p.strip() for p in s.split(\",\") if p.strip() != \"\"]\n    return [int(round(float(p))) for p in parts]\n\n\ndef get_bbox_from_row(row):\n    try:\n        xmin = int(round(float(row[\"xmin\"])))\n        ymin = int(round(float(row[\"ymin\"])))\n        xmax = int(round(float(row[\"xmax\"])))\n        ymax = int(round(float(row[\"ymax\"])))\n    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):\n        xs = coords_to_int_list(row.get(\"coords_x\", []))\n        ys = coords_to_int_list(row.get(\"coords_y\", []))\n        if not xs or not ys:\n            return None\n        xmin, xmax = min(xs), max(xs)\n        ymin, ymax = min(ys), max(ys)\n    if xmax < xmin:\n        xmin, xmax = xmax, xmin\n    if ymax < ymin:\n        ymin, ymax = ymax, ymin\n    return xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax\n\n\ndef mask_to_largest_contour(mask, min_area=4):\n    mask_u8 = mask.astype(np.uint8)\n    contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask_u8, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL,\n                                   cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_NONE)\n    if not contours:\n        return None\n    contours = sorted(contours, key=cv2.contourArea, reverse=True)\n    largest = contours[0]\n    if cv2.contourArea(largest) < min_area:\n        return None\n    return largest.reshape(-1, 2)\n\n\ndef simplify_contour(contour, epsilon_ratio=0.002):\n    if contour is None or len(contour) < 3:\n        return contour\n    perim = cv2.arcLength(contour, True)\n    eps = max(0.5, epsilon_ratio * perim)\n    approx = cv2.approxPolyDP(contour, eps, True)\n    if approx is None or len(approx) < 3:\n        return contour\n    return approx.reshape(-1, 2)\n\n\ndef main():\n    args = parse_args()\n\n    os.makedirs(args.output_path, exist_ok=True)\n\n    image = load_image(args.rgb_path)\n    H, W = image.shape[:2]\n\n    df = pd.read_csv(args.csv_path, index_col=0)\n\n    device = \"cpu\"\n    sam = sam_model_registry[\"vit_t\"](checkpoint=args.weights_path)\n    sam.to(device=device)\n    sam.eval()\n    predictor = SamPredictor(sam)\n    predictor.set_image(image)\n\n    bboxes = []\n    indices = []\n    for idx, row in df.iterrows():\n        bb = get_bbox_from_row(row)\n        if bb is None:\n            continue\n        xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax = bb\n        xmin = max(0, min(W - 1, xmin))\n        xmax = max(0, min(W - 1, xmax))\n        ymin = max(0, min(H - 1, ymin))\n        ymax = max(0, min(H - 1, ymax))\n        if xmax <= xmin or ymax <= ymin:\n            continue\n        bboxes.append([xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax])\n        indices.append(idx)\n\n    areas = [(b[2] - b[0]) * (b[3] - b[1]) for b in bboxes]\n    order = sorted(range(len(bboxes)), key=lambda i: areas[i], reverse=True)\n\n    refined_polys = {}\n    union_mask = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=np.uint8)\n\n    for rank in tqdm(order, desc=\"Refining masks\"):\n        original_idx = indices[rank]\n        xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax = bboxes[rank]\n        box = np.array([xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax], dtype=np.float32)\n\n        with torch.no_grad():\n            masks, scores, _ = predictor.predict(box=box, multimask_output=True)\n\n        best_idx = int(np.argmax(scores))\n        sam_mask = masks[best_idx]\n\n        available = sam_mask.astype(np.uint8)\n        available[union_mask > 0] = 0\n\n        contour = mask_to_largest_contour(available, min_area=4)\n        if contour is None or len(contour) < 3:\n            contour = mask_to_largest_contour(sam_mask, min_area=4)\n            if contour is None or len(contour) < 3:\n                continue\n\n        contour = simplify_contour(contour)\n\n        refined_polys[original_idx] = contour\n\n        fill = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=np.uint8)\n        cv2.fillPoly(fill, [contour.astype(np.int32)], 1)\n        union_mask = np.maximum(union_mask, fill)\n\n    new_xmins = []\n    new_ymins = []\n    new_xmaxs = []\n    new_ymaxs = []\n    new_coords_x = []\n    new_coords_y = []\n\n    for idx, row in df.iterrows():\n        if idx in refined_polys:\n            poly = refined_polys[idx]\n            xs = poly[:, 0].astype(int).tolist()\n            ys = poly[:, 1].astype(int).tolist()\n            xmin = int(min(xs))\n            xmax = int(max(xs))\n            ymin = int(min(ys))\n            ymax = int(max(ys))\n            cx_str = \",\".join(str(int(v)) for v in xs)\n            cy_str = \",\".join(str(int(v)) for v in ys)\n        else:\n            xmin = int(round(float(row[\"xmin\"])))\n            ymin = int(round(float(row[\"ymin\"])))\n            xmax = int(round(float(row[\"xmax\"])))\n            ymax = int(round(float(row[\"ymax\"])))\n            cx_str = str(row[\"coords_x\"])\n            cy_str = str(row[\"coords_y\"])\n\n        new_xmins.append(xmin)\n        new_ymins.append(ymin)\n        new_xmaxs.append(xmax)\n        new_ymaxs.append(ymax)\n        new_coords_x.append(cx_str)\n        new_coords_y.append(cy_str)\n\n    df[\"xmin\"] = new_xmins\n    df[\"ymin\"] = new_ymins\n    df[\"xmax\"] = new_xmaxs\n    df[\"ymax\"] = new_ymaxs\n    df[\"coords_x\"] = new_coords_x\n    df[\"coords_y\"] = new_coords_y\n    df[\"type\"] = \"polyline\"\n\n    out_csv = os.path.join(args.output_path, \"refined_masks.csv\")\n    df.to_csv(out_csv)\n    print(f\"Saved refined masks to {out_csv}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()","filePath":"/app/convert_masks.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/convert_masks.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/convert_masks.py","time":{"start":1782742210829,"end":1782742210849}},"id":"prt_f13b758ff001dgICMInvgRGIvj","sessionID":"ses_0ec4bf7a7fferOdI4AXsIMyN02","messageID":"msg_f13b6df8b001tbnpC9s5ilQh9V"}}

{"type":"text","timestamp":1782742308045,"sessionID":"ses_0ec4bf7a7fferOdI4AXsIMyN02","part":{"id":"prt_f13b8c38b0010Nyj6PFFFZ0Wsk","messageID":"msg_f13b8be9c001WBQbJDMjcpmmnD","sessionID":"ses_0ec4bf7a7fferOdI4AXsIMyN02","type":"text","text":"The image can't be displayed here, but the numerical verification confirms everything is working.\n\nSummary of `/app/convert_masks.py`:\n\n- **Args (argparse)**: `--weights_path`, `--output_path`, `--rgb_path`, `--csv_path`.\n- **Model**: MobileSAM `vit_t` registry, loaded from `--weights_path`, run on CPU.\n- **Per-image**: `predictor.set_image()` is called once; each cell mask is predicted with its `xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax` bounding-box prompt (computed from the row when needed).\n- **Best mask**: Of MobileSAM's three outputs, the highest-scoring mask is selected.\n- **No overlap**: Masks are processed largest-bbox-first; before extracting the contour, the SAM mask is intersected with the complement of the union of all previously finalized masks. The largest contour of the remainder is kept (with a fallback to the full SAM mask if nothing remains).\n- **Polyline conversion**: Contours are extracted with `cv2.findContours`, simplified with `cv2.approxPolyDP`, and saved as closed polylines; `xmin/xmax/ymin/ymax` are recomputed from the contour so the bbox always matches.\n- **Single contiguous mask**: Only `RETR_EXTERNAL` + the largest contour are used, guaranteeing one connected region.\n- **Output**: A CSV matching the input schema (same index, classification columns, and `type=\"polyline\"`), saved as `<output_path>/refined_masks.csv`.\n\nVerification on the demo set: all 48 cells converted to polylines, 0 overlapping pixels, 0 cells with multiple connected components, and every saved bbox exactly matches its contour.","time":{"start":1782742303627,"end":1782742308042}}}
